name: pre-edit-recorded-content-missing-from-disk-is-still-admitted
description: Session A's first read of CLAUDE.md seeds v1 with A's hash, which is not the bytes on disk. In strict mode too, the pre-edit disk check only informs: the edit is admitted with disk_differs and the out-of-band notice, never denied. Both backends (cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#205).

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: ⚠ CLAUDE.md on disk differs from v1, the last content committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change: it was made outside the coordinator. Read CLAUDE.md before relying on it, and do not write it from an earlier read; that write would replace the change.
